images.author: Robert Sachowski
images.why: Strongest match: solitary, full-body polar bear walking through snow in Churchill, Canada; clean surroundings suit a near-square crop. URL requests 3000 px width.

images.author: Dustin Bowdige
images.why: Documented wild Churchill bear amid snowy tundra vegetation. Compact seated pose offers a poster alternative, although the legs are less clearly displayed. URL requests 3000 px width.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Isolated wild Grévy’s zebra in Samburu grassland, with narrow stripes and a softly separated background. Original asset URL; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Nicolas Urlacher
images.why: Species-specific photographer gallery identifies Samburu National Reserve; attractive morning light and clear diagnostic markings. Resolution fallback: linked derivative does not establish a 2000 px original.

images.author: Krushnamegh Kunte
images.why: Documented male kiang at Rhongo, Ladakh, photographed August 13, 2021; full-body walking view with brown upperparts and white underside against green grass. Native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Krushnamegh Kunte
images.why: Alternative view of the documented wild male at Rhongo, with rocky plateau terrain and warm mountain colours. Stronger habitat context; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Michal Vaško

images.author: Lance B. Carter

images.author: Harrison Hargrave

images.author: Hugh Lansdown
